text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — sample-apps failing on Node/edge after the package.json exports change. Repro: 
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference' in a Cloudflare Worker -> runtime throws 'Cannot find module' on startup. Anyone seen this?

Samir Patel: Yup. Saw it locally with wrangler. The exports map uses conditional fields (import/require) and subpath redirects but the edge resolver doesn't pick the import path, falls through and errors.

Maria Gomez: Also getting TypeScript noise — VSCode can't find types for the package when using the subpath import. We removed the top-level "types" pointer last release which probably broke editor DX.

Jake: Workaround in sample app was to switch to deep import: 
const { RedwoodClient } = await import('@redwood/inference/dist/esm/index.js')
Not ideal for onboarding.

Alex Chen: CI smoke tests caught it: @ci-bot reported failures on the edge sample suite.

ci-bot: Build #452 — sample-apps/edge-integration — FAILED. Error snippet:
```
Error: Could not resolve '@redwood/inference' from worker-entry.js
  at Resolver.resolve (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
```
Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/452 (redacted)

Samir Patel: Quick show of our exports in package.json (current):
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
Edge runtimes and some bundlers expect a bare "./" fallback or different subpath shapes. Also we don't expose a subpath for the types so TypeScript can't find index.d.ts unless consumers resolve to dist directly.

Maria Gomez: For typings the simple fix is to add a top-level "types": "dist/index.d.ts" in package.json and ensure our d.ts is emitted next to the esm build. That will restore editor DX quickly.

Samir Patel: For the runtime resolution issue I propose adding explicit subpath entries and a browser-compatible field. Example patch idea:
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "default": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
And add top-level "types": "dist/index.d.ts", and keep a "module"/"main" fallback for older bundlers.

Jake: Also noticed auth/retry wrapper isn't available from the ESM build in some edge builds — code that expects the exported RetryableAuth class throws at runtime. Maybe our build excluded a polyfilled file from the esm bundle. That's why some sample apps fail in auth-handshake.

Maria Gomez: Good catch — looks like rollup config treats the auth folder as external for esm. Quick test: when I include the auth file in esm build it fixes the worker error but then CJS build duplicates symbols. We need a unified build that publishes all necessary entry points.

Alex Chen: Action items: 
- Samir: open a small PR to patch package.json exports + add top-level types and module/main fallbacks. (will also add ./package.json export)
- Maria: adjust rollup config so auth/retry is included in ESM bundle and ensure d.ts emitted.
- Jake: add a micro-fix in sample-apps to use deep import as a temporary workaround and add a note in onboarding guide.

Samir Patel: On it — I'll target a patch release (v0.14.1) with these fixes today. Will ping this thread with PR link. :shipit:

Alex Chen: Thanks — let's get this in asap, onboarding is getting hit by this one. :thumbsup:
